verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not show that this applicable CPU-compute capability is delivered. AMD's product page lists only cTDP (45-120W) and Curve Optimizer support, with no core or thread counts and no boost clocks. The community items mention CPU benchmarks only to criticize the comparison methodology and give no multi-core or compile-time results. The remaining docs cover NPU/GPU AI tooling, which is off-topic for this story.
